findings.issue: No test script, runner, or test files anywhere in app/; all correctness rests on the acceptance suite
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or the TanStack Start-recommended runner) and start with unit tests for app/src/lib/format.ts, which is pure and spec-heavy

findings.issue: Filtering (case-insensitive humanized-name substring, type/generation predicates), 48-per-page slicing and page clamping are completely unguarded
findings.suggestion: Extract filter+paginate into a pure function and unit-test edge cases: empty query, page beyond totalPages, page clamping, 'No Pokémon found'

findings.issue: URL search-state validation and default-param omission (page 1 omitted, filters reset page) are untested; a regression breaks deep links like /?type=fire&generation=generation-i
findings.suggestion: Unit-test validateSearch and the setFilter patch logic (page reset, empty-value omission) directly against URL objects

findings.issue: 'Missing values sort last in both directions' is subtle comparator logic with no test; a naive comparator refactor puts nulls first in descending order
findings.suggestion: Unit-test sortRows with null power/accuracy rows for both directions, plus aria-sort state via a render test

findings.issue: Alt-form exclusion (id > 10000), dedup and dex ordering in cardsForPokemonRefs are untested; also hiddenById (data.ts:415-419) uses last-write-wins when a Pokémon has an ability both hidden and normal
findings.suggestion: Table-test cardsForPokemonRefs with mixed refs (alternate forms, duplicates, out-of-order ids) and pin down the hidden-flag semantics

findings.issue: Default game selection (highest order), method ordering (Level Up/Machine/Egg/Tutor then alphabetical) and default row ordering are untested
findings.suggestion: Unit-test buildPokemonPageData's games/selectedGame/methods output against a small fixture Pokémon payload

findings.issue: Only ApiError 404 becomes notFound(); any other API error (500, network) rethrows into an unhandled loader error path with no test coverage
findings.suggestion: Add an error test that stubs apiGet to reject with 500 and asserts the app renders a useful error state rather than a crash

findings.issue: Cache failure eviction (`p.catch(() => cache.delete(path))`) is untested; a refactor caching rejections would make transient API failures permanent, and the module-level caches in data.ts have the same pattern
findings.suggestion: Unit-test apiGet retry-after-failure semantics and the data.ts promise-cache reset behaviour

summary: The app ships zero tests of its own; every line of its substantial data-transformation, filtering, pagination, URL-state and sorting logic is protected only by the externally-provided acceptance suite. The pure helpers in format.ts and the view-model builders in data.ts are precisely the code that will break silently during a refactor. Adding even a small vitest layer over format.ts, the home filter/paginate logic and MovesTable's missing-values-last comparator would be the highest-value first step.
